rows.en: I see, that's worrying…
Mr. Sakata… I hear your household refused to evacuate?

Yes… In her condition, evacuating anywhere far is out of the question.

Besides… I don't much care for that sort of thing myself.
If you stay in a place like this, you'll die!

I was only 3…

My mother flatly refused to evacuate to the countryside, and every time there was an air raid, she'd jump into a rock air-raid shelter and pray to the B-29s flying overhead: "Please, don't kill this child, at least"…

Hehe… I guess I take after my mother, don't I?
But the Spiner's intense heat will melt even steel and concrete.
The Spiner… They really mean to use it?
I opposed it strongly, but…
If they use something like that, what will become of Tokyo…
That's why they expanded the evacuation order to all of Tokyo!
Isn't there some way to get it called off?
The Director has made his decision… It can't be changed now!
Go, take care of Jiro for me! Get him evacuated somewhere safe.
What about you, Mr. Sakata?
No, bro!! I'm staying with you! Bro!

MAT's mission is to protect people's freedom and to fight, at the risk of our lives, whatever threatens it!!

Captain! Isn't that what MAT exists for?
Come with me! Let's uphold MAT's pride together and carry out our mission!
That won't do! We can't call off the Spiner attack!
Please give MAT one more chance! We'll take it down, I promise!
You say that, but… have you got any concrete plan?
Sir… We'll fire tranquilizer rounds into the kaiju's eyes!
But… the target is moving!
That's why… we'll close to within 10 meters before firing.
Do you really think you can get that close?
We'll try!
Sounds impossible to me.
Please let us do it! I'm begging you!
Director! A kaiju has appeared! It's believed to be the oil monster Takkong.
Mm… How are the Spiner launch preparations?
Yes, sir… It can be fired at any time! However…
What is it?
How about leaving this to MAT?
You too, saying such things?
Director! Please give MAT one more chance! I'm begging you!
Officer Kishida, ask your uncle!

………

Director, I'm asking you too! Let's try firing tranquilizer rounds, as the Captain proposes! If that fails, then the Spiner…
I see…
Director!
Please!
Let us do it.
Director…
Let MAT do it! Please.
Mm… But if you fail, MAT will be disbanded! Understood?
Yes, sir…
Go ahead and try!
Thank you very much.
Captain…
Captain!
Captain, this is our last chance! Let's make it count with a single shot.
Our MAT is staking everything on this battle! Let's fight with all our strength!!

Stay calm…

Aim for the eyes! Get as close as you can and fire! Commence battle!!
Right, fire!
We did it!!
…!? Car 1's in danger! Fire!
Everyone, are you all right!? Don't let the kaiju get to the factory! We stop it right here, no matter what!
Yes, sir!
"Hideki Go… I am Ultraman."
Ultraman?
"You died once, back then… And so I entrusted my life to you."
So that's what happened… I thought it was strange too, a man who'd died coming back to life.
"You are now Ultraman!"
Me… Ultraman?
"This is a secret between you and me alone. Let us fight together to protect the freedom and happiness of humankind!"
I'm Ultraman… My mission is to fight every enemy that threatens the freedom and happiness of humankind…
Nngh… Outdone by those Space Sheriffs once again!
Nuooh!! You won't be able to find Jimmy Kitahara either, hahaha…
Who are you?
We are not your enemies. We came to protect you…
We've been looking for you at the TDF's request. Thank goodness! You're safe…
Thank you all for your trouble. We'll take it from here.
Hold on! What are you going to do with Mr. Kitahara?
Please wait! What are you going to do with Mr. Kitahara?

That is classified TDF information! I'm under no obligation to answer…

There's no need for us in the UCMA to have doubts! All we need is to carry out orders from above, without fail!

You still don't get it? Don't make me repeat myself!

Now, Kitahara… you're coming with us! Leaving the hospital without permission would normally be a serious offense, you know?
Stop…
If you come quietly, there's room for leniency… Now, do as you're told!
Stoooop!! Stay back! Please, stay back! Stay baaack!!
Mr. Kitahara!!
Mr. Kitahara…

U06131: 叔父様 suggests Kishida is Director Yamaoka's nephew; rendered 'ask your uncle'.
U06132: 握事通り read as 提案通り ('as the Captain proposes').
U06153-U06159: Ultraman's 『』 lines rendered in double quotes.

new_names.why: glossary has 麻酔弾 = Tranquilizer; plural noun phrase used in dialogue
